'''Version 1.9.8''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on December 12th 2022.  It was 15.53 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

====<u>Configuration</u>====
*"Version x Orb Item Cooldown" minimum value from 1 to 0
*"[[Fear]] Block Fail Chance" from 0.5 to 0
*"Fear Item Fail Chance" from 0.5 to 0
*"Fear Inventory Fail Chance" from 0.5 to 0
*"[[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] Stage II Follow Range" from 24 to 32
*"Nexus Stage III Follow Range" from 32 to 48
*Reduced chance/amount of bone items dropped by all Primitive/Adapted versions
 
*New options:
**"Version [[:Category:Adapted Parasites|Adapted]] Food Item Chance" "Chance (1=100%) of contaminating food when hitting you." SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]] Food Item Amount" "Amount of food to be contaminated." SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]] Food Item Amount" "Amount of food to be contaminated." SRParasites.cfg
**"Version [[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] Food Item Amount" "Amount of food to be contaminated." SRParasites.cfg
**"[[Stage I Dispatcher]] Extra Follow Range" - "Follow range Multiplier for Stage I Dispatcher" - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Stage II Dispatcher]] Extra Follow Range" - "Follow range Multiplier for Stage I Dispatcher" - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Stage III Dispatcher]] Extra Follow Range" - "Follow range Multiplier for Stage I Dispatcher" - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Stage IV Dispatcher]] Extra Follow Range" - "Follow range Multiplier for Stage I Dispatcher" - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Heavy Carrier]] Damage Multiplier" - "Damage multiplier for Heavy Carrier." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Flying Carrier]] Damage Multiplier" - "Damage multiplier for Flying Carrier." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Assimilated Horse]] Explotion Multiplier" - "Explotion damage will take base Damage and multiply it by this value." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"[[Heavy Bomber]] Explotion Multiplier" - "Explotion damage will take base Damage and multiply it by this value." - SRParasitesMobs.cfg
**"Mod Easter Egg (Nametags)" - "Chance to spawn an [[Assimilated Adventurer|adventurer]]/[[thrall]] with a nametag." - SRParasites.cfg
 
====<u>General changes</u>====
*Minimum damage is now multiplied by [[viral]] amplifier + 1
*Removed minimum damage knockback
*Removed EntityNade knockback
*Changed spawn egg texture for all Pure versions
*Debug messages will only show if "[[Scent System|Scent]] Debug" is set to true
 
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*[[Orb|Orbs]] now contaminate food<ref>Food will be irreversibly transformed into [[Infected Flesh]].</ref>
*[[Bogle]] explotions will now store blocks instead of spawning drops
*[[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure]] spawning [[Seizer]] frequency increased by 1 second
*[[Overseer|Overseer's]] burst of shots reduced from 6 to 4 shots
*Heavy/Flying Carrier explotion damage type changed from GENERIC to WITHER
*Heavy/Flying Carrier explotion damage value will now take ATTACK_DAMAGE attribute value
*[[Assimilated Horse]] explotion damage value will now take ATTACK_DAMAGE attribute value multiplied by "Assimilated Horse Explotion Multiplier" 
*[[Mangler]] attack cooldown decreased from 10 to 6
*[[Primitive Manducater|Primitive]] and [[Adapted Manducater]] attack cooldown decreased from 10 to 6
*[[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckons]] will now throw bombs if attacker is too close
*[[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatchers]] will now throw bombs if attacker is too close
*Bombs will now deal minimum damage
*EntityRemain will now spawn Parasites with the Debar effect
*[[Haunter]] fire rate decreased
*[[Bogle]] explotion strength decreased
*[[:Category:Primitive Parasites|Primitive]] and higher versions will now have the ability to contaminate food in your inventory by hitting you
*Walking head will try to rebuild themselves by attacking [[Incomplete Forms|incomplete forms (Medium size)]]

*All bombs will now spawn EntityToxicCloud with the following effects:
**Poison
**[[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]
**[[Viral|VIRAL]]

*Attribute value changes:
**[[Stage I Dispatcher|Dispatcher SI]] attack damage from 0 to 3 
**[[Stage II Dispatcher|Dispatcher SII]] attack damage from 0 to 7 
**[[Stage III Dispatcher|Dispatcher SIII]] attack damage from 0 to 14 
**[[Stage IV Dispatcher|Dispatcher SIV]] attack damage from 0 to 22
 
*Tweaked Dispatcher Combat AI:
**Will unhide infected mobs regardless of their coth amplifier
**Pods spawned from SIV will now spawn closer to its target
**Dispatcher scan cooldown increased from 45 to 80, if target != null then cooldown is 40
